title: 快递与收件

words.example: I have a package to pick up.
Do I need to leave a signature?
Can I schedule a pickup tomorrow?
Please put it in the parcel locker.

sentences.en: I have a package to pick up.
sentences.speak: I have a package to pick up.

sentences.en: Could you leave it at the front desk?
sentences.speak: Could you leave it at the front desk?

sentences.en: Do I need to sign for it?
sentences.speak: Do I need to sign for it?

scenarios.title: 跟快递员改放到前台
scenarios.setting: 你不在家，快递员来电，你希望把包裹放在前台。

lines.en: Hi, I have a package for you. Are you home?
lines.zh: 你好，有你的包裹。你在家吗？
lines.speak: Hi, I have a package for you. Are you home?

lines.en: I'm not home right now. Could you leave it at the front desk?
lines.zh: 我现在不在家。可以放到前台吗？
lines.speak: I'm not home right now. Could you leave it at the front desk?

lines.en: Sure. Do I need a signature?
lines.speak: Sure. Do I need a signature?

lines.en: No, just leave it with the receptionist. Thanks.
lines.zh: 不用，交给前台就行。谢谢。
lines.speak: No, just leave it with the receptionist. Thanks.

scenarios.title: 前台取件发现破损
scenarios.setting: 你到前台取包裹，发现外箱有破损，向工作人员说明。

lines.en: I have a package to pick up. The name is Zhou.
lines.zh: 我有一个包裹要取，名字是 Zhou。
lines.speak: I have a package to pick up. The name is Zhou.

lines.en: Here it is. Please sign here.
lines.speak: Here it is. Please sign here.

lines.en: The box is damaged. Can I check it first?
lines.zh: 箱子破了。我可以先打开看一下吗？
lines.speak: The box is damaged. Can I check it first?

lines.en: Of course. If something is missing, we can help you report it.
lines.zh: 当然。如果少了东西，我们可以帮你报备。
lines.speak: Of course. If something is missing, we can help you report it.

lines.en: Thanks. What's the tracking number, just in case?
lines.zh: 谢谢。以防万一，单号是多少？
lines.speak: Thanks. What's the tracking number, just in case?

task: 把「改送到前台 + 发现破损」六句连说两遍并录音自听
